criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Extend Product with class currency = "NGN" and per-instance stock. Change stock on one of two products; show the other is unchanged and both initially use NGN. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement __str__ returning "Pen: 4 units" for name Pen and stock 4. Check zero stock and a different name. Keep printing outside the method. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement __repr__ including class name, name, price and stock. Show repr(product) and str(product), and explain which reader each helps. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use a stock property backed by _stock. Reject negatives, text, fractions and bool; allow 0. Attempt an invalid assignment and show the previous value remains intact. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement Product.from_dict(record) as a classmethod using cls. Accept name/price/stock and reuse validation. Demonstrate valid input and a missing required field with a clear error. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Reproduce class tags = [] with two products. Append on one and show leakage. Move list creation into __init__, rerun, and show independent tags. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Construct two separate products with identical fields. Document whether your class defines __eq__; demonstrate is and == and explain their observed results without claiming they mean the same thing. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
